decisions.reason: The materials management module was launched only in 2024 as an in-house extension of the core practice software, so management will attribute modest uptake to a normal ramp-up rather than abandon a recent investment that fits its integrated-practice strategy.

Secure healthcare messaging has its own page, ties into telematics infrastructure requirements, and is central to the firm's announced digital, paperless direction, so the public commitment and strategic centrality make keeping it highly likely.
